<profile>
Sells: Tidewell Candles sells candles: scented container candles and unscented taper candles. The range includes an 8 oz sea salt soy candle hand-poured in Portland, Maine, a 12 oz cedar candle in a coconut and soy wax blend with a crackling cherry-wood wick, and a pair of 10-inch pure beeswax tapers made with beeswax from Maine apiaries.
Audience: People shopping for home candles who care about the wax and wick, such as soy, coconut-soy or pure beeswax, hand-poured or locally sourced in Maine.
Country: US
Tone: friendly
Never say: —
</profile>

<products>
<group name="Candle">
  P1: Sea Salt Soy Candle, 8 oz
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle is 8 oz.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle is made of 100% soy wax.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle is poured by hand in Portland, Maine.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle has a cotton wick.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle's wick is lead-free.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle has a burn time of about 45 hours.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle comes in an 8 oz amber glass jar.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle's jar has a tin lid.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle has scent notes of sea salt, driftwood, and sage.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle is made by Tidewell.
  P2: Cedar Wood-Wick Candle, 12 oz
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle is 12 oz.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle is made by Tidewell.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle is made with a coconut and soy wax blend.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle has a cherry-wood wick that crackles as it burns.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle has a burn time of about 60 hours.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle comes in a 12 oz ceramic vessel.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle's vessel is reusable.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle's wick should be trimmed to 3 mm before each burn.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle has scent notes of cedar, black pepper, and vetiver.
</group>
<group name="Taper">
  P3: Beeswax Taper Candles, pair
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles come as a pair.
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles set contains two tapers that are 10 inches long.
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles are made of pure beeswax from Maine apiaries.
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles are unscented.
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles have a standard 7/8-inch base that fits most candlesticks.
    - Each Beeswax Taper Candle burns about 8 hours.
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles are dripless when kept away from drafts.
</group>
</products>
